instruction: In the Word document, each cue references a PPT file and a page number. Add a hyperlink in every cue paragraph to the referenced .pptx file. The hyperlink only needs to target the correct .pptx file; it does not need to open the specified slide.

eval_rules.description: 每个 PPT 页面提示段落均包含指向所引用 PPT 文件的超链接
